title: kpiTile request
description: One number with a mandatory comparison, and a mini trend of the blocks before it: the last block is the number. Give either window (rolling windows) or unit (calendar periods). The warehouse computes each block and, in previous, the value it is compared with (REQ-058).

metric.description: Identifier of the metric, e.g. creditLeads. Used as title when no title is given.

title.description: Title above the chart. States what is shown, not a conclusion.

measureType.description: Kind of number: additive or unique for a count; perUnit for a mean or median per unit where the spread between the units is the question, such as an amount per lead (REQ-070, REQ-074); ratio for a numerator divided by a denominator, only in movingWindowRatio and calendarRatio (REQ-074, REQ-076). Required until Domain Hub or the dbt YAML supplies it.

uniqueAggregation.description: Required for unique counts: daily (the uniques per day; never summed) or overPeriod (the uniques over the whole block, counted in the warehouse; only as a total).

statistic.description: The value both lines show: sum (the total per block, a square), mean (a diamond with ±1 sd) or median (a dot with P25–P75). A block carries only the fields of this statistic.

window.description: Rolling windows of this many days: 1 or a multiple of 7. Give either window or unit.

unit.description: Calendar periods: week (ISO), month, quarter or year. Give either unit or window.

asOf.description: The last complete day of the data. A calendar period that ends after it is still running. Yesterday in Brussels when absent.

format.description: Output format. Only svg is available in v0.

locale.description: Language of titles, labels and messages, e.g. en or nl-BE. Unknown locales fall back to English.

context.description: Provenance and status for the footer. Missing values are shown as unknown.

meta.description: Metadata of the chart (REQ-010): the question that started it, references, the query, who asked and who built it, and the day it was compiled. Only what is given is shown (REQ-020).

question.description: The question that started the chart.

references.description: Links to Jira, Slack or anything else.

query.description: The query behind the data, shown as written.

compiledOn.description: The day the chart was compiled. When absent, the day it is drawn, in Brussels.

points.description: One row per block, oldest first or in any order, computed in the warehouse (REQ-058). The last block is the number; the blocks before it make the mini trend.

end.description: With window: the last day of the window.

period.description: With unit: the ISO name of the period.

sum.description: The total of the block; null when the block has no data.

mean.description: The mean of the block; null when the block has no data.

sd.description: Sample standard deviation (n − 1, like STDDEV in BigQuery).

n.description: Number of observations behind the value, as counted where the value is computed (REQ-043).

median.description: The median of the block; null when the block has no data.

previous.description: The value this block is compared with (see comparison), in the field of the statistic; null when it has no data. The last block needs it: a number without a comparison says nothing.

comparison.description: What the number is compared with: previousPeriod (the block just before) or lastYear (the same block a year earlier), as delivered in previous (REQ-067). Default: the period before for a window of up to 14 days, last year for longer windows and calendar periods. With lastYear, the mini trend shows last year as a grey shadow line.
